before_times: The town or ZIP, and what kind of property: a house, a condo or townhouse, several units, or land
About how many square feet, and the year built
What the appraisal is for: an estate or date-of-death value, a divorce, a sale, a tax appeal, removing mortgage insurance, insurance or a gift
The value date: today, or a past date like a date of death
Is a lender asking for it? (A lender orders its own appraisal.)
Is the home lived in or empty?
after_time: Pets at the house, and where they'll be
Additions or remodels since it was built
Who will let the appraiser in: you, a tenant or an agent
Will you meet the appraiser at the start?
secure_page_only: The agent's or tenant's mobile, and the access link they fill in
The lockbox or door code, typed only by whoever sets up access
Deeds, earlier appraisals, leases and lists of improvements
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the property or acts for the owner: an executor, a trustee, an attorney or an agent. A tenant books only with the owner's yes. Nobody books a mortgage appraisal that a lender will rely on: the lender orders those. Nobody under 18 books or signs.

stop: a ceiling or floor giving way right now
safety_and_stop_words.go_on: No, for gas, sparks, smoke, a carbon monoxide alarm or a ceiling or floor giving way. Yes, with the unsafe area left out, for live wires or flooding.
stop_action: A gas smell, sparks, smoke or a carbon monoxide alarm: whoever is there gets out first, then calls 911 and the gas company from outside. No booking until the home is safe.
A ceiling or floor giving way right now: everyone gets out and stays out, then calls 911. No booking until the fire department or the building department says it is safe to go in.

Live wires hanging down or flooding up to the outlets: stay away from that area, and call 911 if anyone is in danger. The appraisal can be booked for the rest of the property; the appraiser will not enter that area, and the report says so.

prep: Every room, closet, attic and garage reachable, with the utilities on
Pets out of the house, or put away
A list of improvements since it was built, with dates, if you have one
Leases and rent amounts for any rented unit

skills: Value consults and report checks at the office
staff.licenses_or_certificates: Each appraiser's own license or certification at the level the property needs, where the state licenses appraisers.
staff.supervision: A trainee appraises only with a supervising appraiser who inspects with them and signs, where the state's rules allow trainees.
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes over $500 and every fee. Pat, the office manager, may too; Sam's answer wins.
staff.stand_in: Another appraiser with the same level and skills may stand in, with the client's OK first.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult who owns the property or acts for the owner: an executor, a trustee, an attorney or an agent. A tenant books only with the owner's yes. Nobody books a mortgage appraisal that a lender will rely on: the lender orders those. Nobody under 18 books or signs.
children_and_age.minors_texts: Nobody under 18 books or signs the engagement letter.

visit.check_in: The owner or occupant, or the agent, lets the appraiser in. For an empty home the appraiser uses the lockbox and DONE confirms the visit. A client who meets the appraiser gives the code at the door, or at the wrap-up.
visit.done: DONE from the appraiser's phone, with photos. The signed report follows by the date promised.
visit.changes_at_visit: An add-on (a rent analysis, a second value date) only if the client says yes first, priced before it is done. The fee never depends on the value found, the loan or the sale closing.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: Each appraiser holds their own state appraiser license or certification at the right level (trainee, licensed, certified residential, certified general). A trainee works under a supervising appraiser who inspects with them and signs the report. A property type above the appraiser's level (multi-unit, land, commercial) is booked only with someone certified for it, where the state's form says so.
license.who: Each appraiser holds their own license. The company holds its own registration where the state asks. Only the appraiser who did the work signs the report.
license.ask: Each appraiser's license or certification number, type and level. The company's registration number, where the state's form asks for one.
license.insurance: Errors-and-omissions insurance where the state's form requires it. Shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie.
license.background: Only where the state's rules require them, or as the business's own word.

never_in_a_text: The street address in a first text to someone new
The value or any part of the report: only the secure link
Why the appraisal is wanted (an estate, a divorce): only the secure page
